    draw_text(d, (1410, 205), tr(language, "深色=OSM建筑并集 · 细线=道路 · 红=轨道 · 蓝=水/门 · ●=站点 · □=校园中心 · 数字=候选", "DARK=OSM BUILDING UNION · FINE=STREET · RED=RAIL · BLUE=WATER/GATE · ●=STATION · □=CAMPUS CENTROID · NUMBER=CANDIDATE"), 10, COLORS["white"], max_width=900)

def a0_logical_px_per_m(denominator: int) -> float:
    """Return logical figure pixels per metre at the current full-size A0 embed."""
    page_w, _ = landscape(A0)
    pt_per_logical_px = (page_w - 110) / FIGURE_LOGICAL_SIZE[0]
    mm_per_logical_px = pt_per_logical_px * 25.4 / 72.0
    return (1000.0 / denominator) / mm_per_logical_px


def _polygon_parts(geometry):
    if geometry.geom_type == "Polygon":
        return [geometry]
    if geometry.geom_type == "MultiPolygon":
        return list(geometry.geoms)
    if geometry.geom_type == "GeometryCollection":
        return [part for part in geometry.geoms if part.geom_type == "Polygon"]
    return []


def _line_parts(geometry):
    if geometry.geom_type == "LineString":
        return [geometry]
    if geometry.geom_type == "MultiLineString":
        return list(geometry.geoms)
    if geometry.geom_type == "GeometryCollection":
        return [part for part in geometry.geoms if part.geom_type == "LineString"]
    return []


def _dimension_line(draw, a, b, label: str, *, color=COLORS["grey"], offset=0):
    ax, ay = a; bx, by = b
    draw.line((ax, ay, bx, by), fill=color, width=2)
    if abs(bx - ax) >= abs(by - ay):
        for x in (ax, bx):
            draw.line((x, ay - 6, x, ay + 6), fill=color, width=2)
        draw_text(draw, ((ax + bx) / 2, ay - 16 - offset), label, 8, color, anchor="mm")
    else:
        for y in (ay, by):
            draw.line((ax - 6, y, ax + 6, y), fill=color, width=2)
        draw_text(draw, (ax + 12 + offset, (ay + by) / 2), label, 8, color, anchor="lm")


def _draw_dazhongsi_context_axon(draw, context: dict[str, Any], model: dict[str, Any], panel, language: str):
    left, top, right, bottom = panel
    draw.rounded_rectangle(panel, radius=18, fill=COLORS["white"], outline=COLORS["light"], width=3)
    draw_text(draw, (left + 28, top + 22), tr(language, "同一几何的场地轴测", "CONTEXT-BOUND AXON FROM THE SAME GEOMETRY"), 18, COLORS["ink"])
    draw_text(draw, (left + 28, top + 52), tr(language, "OSM 建筑仅作平面剪影；没有高度、地块或权属证据", "OSM FOOTPRINTS FLAT · NO HEIGHT, PARCEL OR TITLE EVIDENCE"), 10, COLORS["oxide"])
    centre = model["center"]
    clip = centre.buffer(85)
    origin_x = left + (right - left) * .47
    origin_y = top + (bottom - top) * .58

    def axon(x, y, z=0.0):
        dx, dy = x - centre.x, y - centre.y
        return origin_x + (dx - dy) * 5.2, origin_y + (dx + dy) * 1.0 - z * 25.0

    # Existing mapped morphology stays flat, so no invented height enters the view.
    for kind in ("street", "rail", "building"):
        for item in context["feature_collection"]["features"]:
            if item.get("properties", {}).get("kind") != kind:
                continue
            geometry = project(shape(item["geometry"])).intersection(clip)
            if geometry.is_empty:
                continue
            if kind == "building":
                for polygon in _polygon_parts(geometry):
                    points = [axon(x, y) for x, y in polygon.exterior.coords]
                    draw.polygon(points, fill=color_mix(COLORS["ink"], COLORS["white"], .22), outline=COLORS["white"])
            else:
                for line in _line_parts(geometry):
                    points = [axon(x, y) for x, y in line.coords]
                    draw.line(points, fill=COLORS["oxide2"] if kind == "rail" else COLORS["light"], width=3 if kind == "rail" else 1)

    for geometry, fill, outline in (
        (model["outer"], None, COLORS["grey"]),
        (model["treated_ground"], COLORS["cyan2"], COLORS["cyan"]),
    ):
        points = [axon(x, y) for x, y in geometry.exterior.coords]
        if fill:
            draw.polygon(points, fill=fill, outline=outline)
        else:
            draw_dashed_polyline(draw, points, fill=outline, width=2, dash=9, gap=6, closed=True)

    corners = list(model["covered_bay"].exterior.coords)[:-1]
    ground = [axon(x, y, 0) for x, y in corners]
    roof = [axon(x, y, DAZHONGSI_FIRST_BAY["eave_underside_target_m"]) for x, y in corners]
    for base, head in zip(ground, roof):
        draw.line((*base, *head), fill=COLORS["oxide2"], width=5)
        draw.ellipse((base[0] - 3, base[1] - 2, base[0] + 3, base[1] + 2), fill=COLORS["oxide2"])
    draw.polygon(roof, fill=color_mix(COLORS["gold"], COLORS["white"], .18), outline=COLORS["gold"])
    for first, second in zip(roof, roof[1:] + roof[:1]):
        draw.line((*first, *second), fill=COLORS["gold"], width=4)
    draw_text(draw, (right - 390, bottom - 80), tr(language, "拟建 8×8 m 可拆第一跨", "PROPOSED 8×8 m DEMOUNTABLE FIRST BAY"), 14, COLORS["oxide2"], max_width=350)
    draw_text(draw, (right - 390, bottom - 47), tr(language, "36×36 m 仅为定位筛查包络", "36×36 m IS AN ORIENTATION-SCREEN ENVELOPE ONLY"), 9, COLORS["grey"], max_width=350)

def figure_dazhongsi_connectivity_v1(context: dict[str, Any], metrics: dict[str, Any], language: str):
    """Show the missing urban scale without inventing an official key-area boundary."""
    model = dazhongsi_first_bay_model(context)
    candidates = dazhongsi_screen_candidates(context)
    im = new_figure()
    d = figure_draw(im)
    draw_text(d, (60, 18), tr(language, "大钟寺 · 四象限联通与候选筛查", "DAZHONGSI · FOUR-QUADRANT CONNECTIVITY + CANDIDATE SCREEN"), 27, COLORS["ink"])
    draw_text(d, (2320, 18), "21", 24, COLORS["gold"], anchor="ra")

    # A 400 m orientation field is intentionally shown instead of the missing
    # official key-area polygon. It supports fieldwork planning, not siting.
    map_panel = (60, 70, 1570, 1335)
    d.rounded_rectangle(map_panel, radius=20, fill=COLORS["white"], outline=COLORS["light"], width=3)
    draw_text(d, (90, 98), tr(language, "400 m 方向场 / 不是重点区红线", "400 m ORIENTATION FIELD / NOT THE KEY-AREA REDLINE"), 20, COLORS["ink"])
    draw_text(d, (90, 132), tr(language, "四个方向先调查；不把 OSM 空白解释为空地", "SURVEY FOUR DIRECTIONS FIRST; OSM GAPS DO NOT MEAN VACANT LAND"), 10, COLORS["oxide"])
    map_rect = (90, 180, 1220, 1310)
    viewport = box(model["anchor"].x - 430, model["anchor"].y - 430, model["anchor"].x + 430, model["anchor"].y + 430)
    conv = map_transform(viewport.bounds, map_rect)
    features = context["feature_collection"]["features"]
    for kind in ("street", "rail", "building"):
        for item in features:
            props = item.get("properties", {})
            if props.get("kind") != kind:
                continue
            geometry = project(shape(item["geometry"])).intersection(viewport)
            if geometry.is_empty:
                continue
            if kind == "street":
                width = 5 if props.get("subkind") in {"trunk", "primary"} else 3 if props.get("subkind") in {"secondary", "tertiary"} else 2
                draw_geom(d, geometry, conv, outline=COLORS["light"], width=width)
            elif kind == "rail":
                draw_geom(d, geometry, conv, outline=COLORS["oxide2"], width=5)
            else:
                draw_geom(d, geometry, conv, fill=color_mix(COLORS["ink"], COLORS["white"], .13), outline=COLORS["white"], width=1)

    catchment = model["anchor"].buffer(400, resolution=48)
    draw_dashed_polyline(d, [conv(x, y) for x, y in catchment.exterior.coords], fill=COLORS["blue"], width=3, dash=12, gap=8, closed=True)
    ax, ay = conv(model["anchor"].x, model["anchor"].y)
    d.ellipse((ax - 12, ay - 12, ax + 12, ay + 12), fill=COLORS["gold"], outline=COLORS["ink"], width=2)
    draw_text(d, (ax + 18, ay - 18), tr(language, "站点记录工作中点", "WORKING STATION-RECORD MIDPOINT"), 9, COLORS["gold"], max_width=180)

    # Directional lines are survey hypotheses, never presented as routes.
    directional = [
        ("NW", -330, 255), ("NE", 330, 255), ("SW", -330, -255), ("SE", 330, -255),
    ]
    for label, dx, dy in directional:
        ex, ey = conv(model["anchor"].x + dx, model["anchor"].y + dy)
        draw_dashed_polyline(d, [(ax, ay), (ex, ey)], fill=COLORS["blue"], width=2, dash=8, gap=6)
        draw_text(d, (ex, ey), f"{label} · " + tr(language, "现场欲望线假设", "FIELD DESIRE-LINE HYPOTHESIS"), 8, COLORS["blue"], anchor="mm")

    station_points: list[Point] = []
    for item in features:
        if item.get("properties", {}).get("kind") != "station_access":
            continue
        geometry = project(shape(item["geometry"]))
        if not viewport.contains(geometry):
            continue
        station_points.append(geometry)
    station_points.sort(key=lambda point: point.distance(model["anchor"]))
    for index, point in enumerate(station_points, start=1):
        px, py = conv(point.x, point.y)
        d.ellipse((px - 9, py - 9, px + 9, py + 9), fill=COLORS["cyan"], outline=COLORS["white"], width=2)
        draw_text(d, (px + 12, py - 8), f"S{index}", 8, COLORS["cyan"])

    for candidate in candidates:
        points = [conv(x, y) for x, y in candidate["outer"].exterior.coords]
        accent = COLORS["gold"] if candidate["id"] == "A" else COLORS["blue"]
        draw_dashed_polyline(d, points, fill=accent, width=5 if candidate["id"] == "A" else 3, dash=12, gap=7, closed=True)
        cx, cy = conv(candidate["center"].x, candidate["center"].y)
        d.ellipse((cx - 13, cy - 13, cx + 13, cy + 13), fill=accent, outline=COLORS["white"], width=2)
        draw_text(d, (cx, cy), candidate["id"], 11, COLORS["ink"] if candidate["id"] == "A" else COLORS["white"], anchor="mm")

    selected = candidates[0]
    if station_points:
        nearest_access = min(station_points, key=lambda point: point.distance(selected["center"]))
        route_points = [conv(selected["center"].x, selected["center"].y), conv(nearest_access.x, nearest_access.y)]
        draw_dashed_polyline(d, route_points, fill=COLORS["gold"], width=4, dash=7, gap=5)
        mid_x = (route_points[0][0] + route_points[1][0]) / 2
        mid_y = (route_points[0][1] + route_points[1][1]) / 2
        draw_text(d, (mid_x + 12, mid_y - 10), tr(language, "无台阶 / 非智能终端路线待实测", "STEP-FREE / NO-PHONE ROUTE TO SURVEY"), 8, COLORS["gold"], max_width=190)

    road_names = ["北三环", "北三环西路", "四道口路", "大钟寺东路", "大钟寺北路", "明光路"]
    for name in road_names:
        pieces = []
        for item in features:
            props = item.get("properties", {})
            if props.get("kind") == "street" and props.get("name") == name:
                clipped = project(shape(item["geometry"])).intersection(viewport)
                if not clipped.is_empty:
                    pieces.append(clipped)
        if not pieces:
            continue
        merged = unary_union(pieces)
        label_point = merged.representative_point()
        lx, ly = conv(label_point.x, label_point.y)
        draw_text(d, (lx, ly), name, 8, COLORS["grey"], anchor="mm")

    # Map-side legend preserves the distinction between evidence and hypotheses.
    legend_x = 1240

    legend_rows = [

        (COLORS["cyan"], tr(language, "OSM 站点 / 出入口记录", "OSM STATION / ACCESS RECORD")),
        (COLORS["blue"], tr(language, "调查假设 / 400 m 方向场", "SURVEY HYPOTHESIS / 400 m FIELD")),
        (COLORS["gold"], tr(language, "A：下一步调查，不是选址", "A: SURVEY NEXT, NOT SITE SELECTION")),
    ]
    for index, (color, label) in enumerate(legend_rows):
        yy = 230 + index * 58
        d.rectangle((legend_x, yy, legend_x + 24, yy + 24), fill=color)
        draw_text(d, (legend_x + 36, yy + 3), label, 9, COLORS["ink"], max_width=275)
    draw_text(d, (legend_x, 545), tr(language, "地图没有表达：", "MAP DOES NOT EXPRESS:"), 13, COLORS["oxide"])
    missing = tr(
        language,
        "正式重点区 polygon\n权属与可用地块\n建筑高度 / 使用 / 状况\n客流与真实欲望线\n地铁保护、管线、消防通道",
        "OFFICIAL KEY-AREA POLYGON\nTITLE + AVAILABLE PARCELS\nHEIGHT / USE / CONDITION\nFOOTFALL + OBSERVED DESIRE LINES\nMETRO, UTILITIES + FIRE ACCESS",
    )
    draw_text(d, (legend_x, 580), missing, 10, COLORS["grey"], max_width=280, spacing=9)
    draw_text(d, (legend_x, 850), tr(language, "已映射快照", "PINNED SNAPSHOT"), 13, COLORS["ink"])
    snapshot_lines = [
        f"{context['statistics']['feature_counts_by_kind']['building']}  BUILDING RECORDS",
        f"{context['statistics']['feature_counts_by_kind']['street']}  STREET RECORDS",
        f"{context['statistics']['feature_counts_by_kind']['rail']}  RAIL RECORDS",
        f"{context['statistics']['feature_counts_by_kind']['station_access']}  STATION/ACCESS RECORDS",
    ]
    draw_text(d, (legend_x, 887), "\n".join(snapshot_lines), 10, COLORS["grey"], max_width=280, spacing=10)
    draw_text(d, (legend_x, 1050), tr(language, "四象限不是功能分区；\n它们是四条现场核查路线。", "QUADRANTS ARE NOT ZONING;\nTHEY ARE FOUR FIELD-AUDIT WALKS."), 11, COLORS["blue"], max_width=280, spacing=10)
    draw_text(d, (90, 1312), f"© OpenStreetMap contributors · ODbL · extract {context['generated_at'].replace('T', ' ')[:16]} UTC", 9, COLORS["grey"])

    # Decision rail: geometry screen -> field evidence -> professional gate.

    decision_label = {

def prototype_stats(proto_key: str) -> dict[str, float]:
    proto = PROTOTYPES[proto_key]
    footprints = [local_element_geometry(item) for item in proto["elements"]]
    support = [local_element_geometry(item) for item in proto["elements"] if item["layer"] == "support"]
    infill = [local_element_geometry(item) for item in proto["elements"] if item["layer"] == "infill"]
    return {
        "footprint": unary_union(footprints).area,
        "support_footprint": unary_union(support).area if support else 0,
        "infill_footprint": unary_union(infill).area if infill else 0,
        "concept_gfa": sum(local_element_geometry(item).area * item["storeys"] for item in proto["elements"]),
        "elements": len(proto["elements"]),
        "thresholds": len(proto.get("thresholds", [])),
        "covered_edge_sqm": sum(edge["w"] * edge["d"] for edge in proto.get("climate_edges", [])),
        "wet_chain_nodes": len(proto.get("wet_chain", [])),
        "operating_modes": len(proto.get("operating_modes", [])),
    }

def fit_image(c, image_path, x, y, width, height, *, min_effective_ppi: float | None = None):
    with Image.open(image_path) as im:
        iw, ih = im.size
    scale = min(width / iw, height / ih)
    effective_ppi = 72.0 / scale
    if min_effective_ppi is not None and effective_ppi + 1e-6 < min_effective_ppi:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"{image_path.name} would render at {effective_ppi:.1f} ppi; "
            f"minimum is {min_effective_ppi:.1f} ppi"
        )
    dw, dh = iw * scale, ih * scale
    c.drawImage(ImageReader(str(image_path)), x + (width - dw) / 2, y + (height - dh) / 2, dw, dh, preserveAspectRatio=True, mask="auto")


def wrap_pdf_text(value: str, width: float, size: float) -> list[str]:
    """Wrap mixed Chinese/Latin copy by measured glyph width.

    ``textwrap`` estimates every character as roughly half an em.  That is
    acceptable for Latin body copy but overfills a narrow rail with full-width
    CJK glyphs.  Greedy measured wrapping keeps words together when possible
    and falls back to character boundaries for unspaced Chinese paragraphs.
    """

    if not value:
        return [""]
    tokens = re.findall(r"\S+\s*", value)
    wrapped: list[str] = []
    current = ""

    def fits(candidate: str) -> bool:
        return pdfmetrics.stringWidth(candidate.rstrip(), FONT_NAME, size) <= width

    for token in tokens:
        candidate = current + token
        if fits(candidate):
            current = candidate
            continue
        if current.strip():
            wrapped.append(current.rstrip())
            current = ""
        if fits(token):
            current = token.lstrip()
            continue
        # Chinese text frequently arrives as one unspaced token.  Split only
        # as far as required by the measured rail width.
        for char in token:
            candidate = current + char
            if current and not fits(candidate):
                wrapped.append(current.rstrip())
                current = char.lstrip()
            else:
                current = candidate
    if current.strip() or not wrapped:
        wrapped.append(current.rstrip())
    return wrapped


def draw_pdf_text(c, x, y, width, lines, size=12, leading=17, color=None):
    c.setFont(FONT_NAME, size)
    c.setFillColor(color or COLORS["ink"])
    text = c.beginText(x, y)
    text.setLeading(leading)
    for para in lines:
        for line in wrap_pdf_text(para, width, size):
            text.textLine(line)
        text.textLine("")
    c.drawText(text)

def figure_path(base_name: str, language: str) -> Path:
    path = Path(base_name)
    localized = path.name if language == "zh" else f"{path.stem}.en{path.suffix}"

def draw_image_crop(
    c,
    image_path: Path,
    x: float,
    y: float,
    width: float,
    height: float,
    crop=(0.0, 0.0, 1.0, 1.0),
    *,
    cover: bool = True,
    max_source_size: tuple[int, int] | None = None,
):
    with Image.open(image_path) as source:
        if max_source_size and (source.width > max_source_size[0] or source.height > max_source_size[1]):
            # A0 keeps the native 3x technical asset.  A3 needs fewer source
            # pixels and has a strict total-package budget; BOX is a true
            # low-pass reduction, never an upscale or a change to the master.
            source.thumbnail(max_source_size, Image.Resampling.BOX)
        left, top, right, bottom = crop
        box_px = (round(source.width * left), round(source.height * top), round(source.width * right), round(source.height * bottom))
        clipped = source.crop(box_px)
        # Photographs may cover their frame, but technical figures must remain
        # complete.  Using cover-mode for diagrams silently removed titles,
        # legends and edge columns in the A3 booklet.
        scale_fn = max if cover else min
        scale = scale_fn(width / clipped.width, height / clipped.height)
        draw_w, draw_h = clipped.width * scale, clipped.height * scale
        buffer = BytesIO()
        if image_path.suffix.lower() == ".png":
            clipped.save(buffer, format="PNG", optimize=True)
        else:
            if clipped.mode != "RGB":
                clipped = clipped.convert("RGB")
            clipped.save(buffer, format="JPEG", quality=88, optimize=True)
        buffer.seek(0)
        c.saveState()
        clip_path = c.beginPath(); clip_path.rect(x, y, width, height)
        c.clipPath(clip_path, stroke=0, fill=0)
        c.drawImage(ImageReader(buffer), x + (width - draw_w) / 2, y + (height - draw_h) / 2, draw_w, draw_h, mask="auto")
        c.restoreState()

def visual_scene_data(language: str) -> str:
    data = {
        "language": language,
        "prototypes": {
            key: {
                "name": proto["name_zh"] if language == "zh" else proto["name_en"],
                "kind": {"proof": "COURT", "origin": "CLOISTER", "exchange": "HALL"}[key],
                "extent": proto["extent"], "elements": proto["elements"],
                "routes": [{"a": list(a), "b": list(b), "kind": kind} for a, b, kind in proto["routes"]],
                "courts": [{"x": x, "y": y, "w": w, "h": h, "name": name} for x, y, w, h, name in proto["courts"]],
                "trees": proto["trees"],
                "tree_canopy_diameter_m": proto.get("tree_canopy_diameter_m", 10),
                "thresholds": proto.get("thresholds", []),
                "climate_edges": proto.get("climate_edges", []),
                "wet_chain": proto.get("wet_chain", []),
                "program_cells": proto.get("program_cells", []),
                "operating_modes": proto.get("operating_modes", []),
            } for key, proto in PROTOTYPES.items()
        },
        "strings": {"cycle": "示意替换周期，不是预测" if language == "zh" else "Illustrative replacement cycle—not a forecast"},
    }
    return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).replace("</", "<\\/")

def render_proposal_reports() -> None:
    renderer = WORKSPACE / "haidian-open-call" / "scripts" / "render_proposal_html.py"
    completed = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, str(renderer), str(ROOT)],
        cwd=str(WORKSPACE / "haidian-open-call"),
        check=False,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
    )
    if completed.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"official proposal HTML renderer failed: {completed.stderr.strip() or completed.stdout.strip()}")
    # The official renderer recognises source/standard/depth/data/metric
    # markers, but leaves the submission's explicit assumption ledger tokens
    # visible as raw ``[assumption:...]`` strings.  Preserve the Markdown
    # source contract and turn only the rendered copies into legible badges.
    for report_name, label, title_prefix in (
        ("proposal.html", "假设", "假设"),
        ("proposal.en.html", "Assumption", "Assumption"),
    ):
        report_path = REPORT / report_name
        rendered = report_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

        def assumption_badge(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
            assumption_id = html.escape(match.group(1), quote=True)
            return (
                f'<sup class="evidence evidence-data evidence-assumption" '
                f'data-evidence-kind="assumption" data-evidence-value="{assumption_id}" '
                f'title="{title_prefix}: {assumption_id}">{label}</sup>'
            )

        rendered = re.sub(r"\[assumption:([A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)\]", assumption_badge, rendered)
        write_text(report_path, rendered)

    listed_paths = {item.get("path") for item in manifest.get("files", []) if isinstance(item, dict)}
    if "simulation.json" not in listed_paths:
        manifest.setdefault("files", []).append({"path": "simulation.json", "role": "evidence_data", "required": True})
    visual_bundle_paths = {
        "visual/assets/reproducibility.json",
        "visual/assets/compiler-source.json",
        "visual/assets/harness-source.json",
        "visual/assets/harness-run.json",
        "visual/assets/corridor-context.json",
        "visual/assets/corridor-room-figure-ground.json",
        "visual/assets/dazhongsi-osm-context.json",
    }
    visual_bundle_paths.update(
        f"visual/assets/{record['filename']}" for record in JINGZHANG_ARCHIVE_IMAGES
    )
    visual_bundle_paths.update(current_harness_artifacts)
    visual_bundle_paths.update(current_direct_sun_artifacts)
    for rel in sorted(visual_bundle_paths):
        if rel not in listed_paths:
            manifest.setdefault("files", []).append({"path": rel, "role": "visualization", "required": True, "language": "neutral"})
    media_posters = {
        "assets/media/proof-yard-winter.jpg": ("验证院冬日概念体验图", "Proof Yard winter conceptual view"),
        "assets/media/origin-cloister-summer.jpg": ("原点廊院夏日概念体验图", "Origin Cloister summer conceptual view"),
        "assets/media/exchange-hall-evening.jpg": ("城市交汇厅傍晚概念体验图", "Exchange Hall evening conceptual view"),
    }
    listed_paths = {item.get("path") for item in manifest.get("files", []) if isinstance(item, dict)}
    for rel, (title_zh, title_en) in media_posters.items():
        if rel not in listed_paths:
            manifest.setdefault("files", []).append({"path": rel, "role": "media_poster", "required": True, "language": "neutral", "title_zh": title_zh, "title_en": title_en})
    manifest["cover_image"] = "assets/media/proof-yard-winter.jpg"
    for item in manifest.get("files", []):
        if item.get("role") != "proposal_figure":
            continue
        figure_path = str(item.get("path", ""))
        if figure_path.endswith(".en.png"):
            item["language"] = "en"
            item["translation_of"] = figure_path.removesuffix(".en.png") + ".png"
        else:
            item["language"] = "zh"
    write_json(ROOT / "manifest.json", manifest)


def main() -> None:
    ensure_dirs()
    harness_evidence = verify_harness_evidence()
    direct_sun_evidence = load_verified_direct_sun_evidence(harness_evidence)
    layers, metrics = write_geometry()
    simulation = attach_harness_evidence(metrics, harness_evidence)
    if direct_sun_evidence is not None:
        attach_direct_sun_evidence(metrics, direct_sun_evidence)
    write_public_reproducibility_bundle(harness_evidence, direct_sun_evidence)
    write_agent_sources_assumptions()
    write_checks_and_matrices(metrics)
    make_figures_v2(layers, metrics, harness_evidence["run_dir"])
    make_pdfs()
    make_visual(metrics)
    write_reports()
    render_proposal_reports()
    update_manifest_for_scaffold()
    print(json.dumps({
        "ok": True,
        "root": str(ROOT),
        "features": {name: len(fc["features"]) for name, fc in layers.items()},
        "metrics": len(metrics["metrics"]),
        "simulation_tasks": simulation["task_count"],
        "direct_sun_run_id": direct_sun_evidence["latest"]["run_id"] if direct_sun_evidence else None,
        "figures": len(list(FIGURES.glob("*.png"))),
        "pdfs": 4,
    }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
